In view of this, the Petitioner has stated that there is no duplication of claims and that the additional capital expenditure has been claimed in line with Regulation 25(2)(c) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations and deserves to be allowed. 35. The matter has been examined. It is observed that the Petitioner has not submitted any supporting document towards the obsolescence of the said asset. In the absence of any documentary evidence supporting the claim, we are not inclined to allow the additional capital expenditure. Accordingly, the claim of the Petitioner is not allowed under Regulation 25(2)(c) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations. However, liberty is granted to the Petitioner to furnish the requisite supporting documents in support of its claim at the time of truing-up of tariff, and the same shall be considered in accordance with law and the applicable provisions of the Tariff Regulations. 42. Since the Petitioner has not sought prior approval of the Commission before undertaking or proposing the said works, as required under the proviso to Regulation 26(1)(h) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations, the claim cannot be admitted at this stage. However, the Petitioner is granted the liberty to claim such additional capital expenditure in accordance with the applicable regulations, along with all supporting documents at the time of truing-up. The Petitioner shall also provide a detailed cost– benefit analysis demonstrating that the proposed replacement of wagons would result in better fuel management, a reduction in operating costs, or other tangible benefits to the beneficiaries. 72.
